node: Indium phosphide substrates and upstream optical materials
summary: Layer 1B expansion finds one relatively pure US-listed substrate candidate, one underfollowed tool supplier tied to InP laser capacity expansion, one speculative testing/qualification beneficiary, and one large-cap reference/vertical-integration anchor. The strongest direct node relation is AXTI as an InP/GaAs/Ge compound-substrate supplier. VECO is a second-order chokepoint candidate because InP laser scaling requires MOCVD, ion-beam, and wet-processing tools. AEHR is more speculative: it is not an InP substrate supplier, but wafer-level burn-in and photonics reliability testing may become a hidden bottleneck if InP laser/photonic-device output ramps. COHR is included as the reference leader/customer-context anchor because its InP capacity ramp and 6-inch line provide evidence that downstream optical-component producers are trying to internalize or secure the material/device layer.
